candidates.title: Pet Naming and Personality Bonding Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated pet naming and trait customization step before issuing the adoption certificate to deepen user connection.
candidates.why: Adoption stage drops to 73.1% and takes a long time (median 89s / mean 1017s); establishing identity early increases completion intent.

new_pet_naming.headline: Name Your Desktop Companion

candidates.title: Multi-Account Sync Verification Split View
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a split view showing active account status on one side and sign-in options on the other.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails reporting pets missing or reset after signing in again with different accounts.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Pets
sign_in.body: Connect your account to preserve your desktop pet state across device reloads.
sign_in.hint: Ensure you log in with the same provider used during original pet creation.

guard.reason: Redesigning the sign-in screen layout while retaining its function inside onboarding is allowed.
